sources.name: USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, Release 28
sources.publisher: USDA Agricultural Research Service, Nutrient Data Laboratory
sources.version: SR28 (September 2015). Its successor is 'SR Legacy' in FoodData Central.
sources.usedFor: Potassium, phosphorus, sodium, protein and water per 100 g of each ingredient.

sources.name: ANSES-CIQUAL French food composition table 2025
sources.publisher: ANSES (French Agency for Food, Environmental and Occupational Health & Safety)
sources.usedFor: European ingredient values (potassium, phosphorus, sodium, protein, water) for 'create your own dish' and new recipe batches. Chosen over USDA when both have the food and CIQUAL's values are complete.
sources.licence: 2020 edition published under Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (Etalab) and CC-BY 4.0, credit ANSES. 2025 terms to be confirmed before release.

sources.name: Sufra typical home recipes, version 1
sources.usedFor: Grams of each ingredient in one portion. Real home recipes vary, so every dish value is 'calculated' and DRAFT until a renal dietitian reviews it.

sources.name: Daily Value on the Nutrition and Supplement Facts Labels; The Lows and Highs of Percent Daily Value
sources.usedFor: Only when the user has no care-team limit yet: 5% DV or less per serving = low, 20% DV or more = high (DV: sodium 2300 mg, potassium 4700 mg, phosphorus 1250 mg). General population rule, labelled as such.

sources.name: KDOQI Clinical Practice Guideline for Nutrition in CKD: 2020 Update
sources.publisher: National Kidney Foundation / American Journal of Kidney Diseases (Ikizler TA et al.)
sources.usedFor: Planned (Phase 7): general guidance shown only when no care-team limit is saved.
